# Qualified Hermes context envelope

The explicit larger context completed the entire deterministic synthetic input and its one-token reply with no abort, inference error, or pressure cancellation. The process stayed below both its expected peak and its 10 GB target. The sampled peak is a measurement, not a mathematical upper bound; the margin to the expected estimate was small, and this single run does not establish every hardware/configuration envelope or long-context answer quality. No system swap-outs occurred during the request. System-wide swap-ins are recorded below. No second model process ran concurrently. Timing is retained for audit, not accepted as a throughput comparison or a new estimator anchor.

Command: `slotstream context-check --model ~/.slotstream/models/qwen38-flash-next-mlx-4bit --memory-gb 10 --vision off --mtp off --tokens 65520 --sample-footprint --json`.

The additional context state and conservative transient reserve are charged before selecting the expert pool, prefill batch, and prefix cache. Ordinary context defaults are unchanged. Experimental optimizations were all off. Source and binary identity are retained below.

This supersedes neither of the failed runs; they remain evidence of the two accounting errors discovered before qualification. See [[sources/runs/2026/09/2026-09-05-hermes-context-first-counterexample]] and [[sources/runs/2026/09/2026-09-05-hermes-planned-context-counterexample]].
